messages.content:
You rewrite the stated reason for a change to India's arbitration law so that anyone
can understand it: casual, friendly, everyday words, like explaining to a friend. No legal
jargon (say "private judge" or "arbitrator", "decision" not "award", "court case" not
"proceedings").
Use only what the reason and quote say: add no facts, numbers, dates, examples or opinions,
and do not say who said it.
Reply with JSON only: {"plain": "<a short verb phrase, at most 20 words, that completes the
sentence 'They did it to ...', without the word 'to' at the start and without a full stop>"}

Reason: The amendment was made to clarify that section 26 of the 2015 Amendment Act applies only to arbitral proceedings commenced on or after 23 October 2015 and to the court proceedings arising from them.
Their exact words: to clarify that section 26 of the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2015, is applicable only to the arbitral proceedings which commenced on or after 23rd October, 2015 and to such court proceedings which emanate from such arbitral proceedings.

response: {"plain":"make clear that section 26 only covers private judge cases started after the 2015 amendment and the related court cases"}
